# BerkahEmas — Software Toko Emas

BerkahEmas is ready-to-use software for Indonesian gold-store operations.
Its product workflows include inventory, POS sales and invoices, buyback records, and reports.

Each business is provisioned with a separate database and a dedicated store subdomain.
Confirm custom-domain availability and setup requirements with the team during a demo.

The existing technical domain and contacts remain in use during the product rebrand.
Request a demo to review store workflows, current plans and device requirements.
No customer-count, rating, certification, revenue or synchronization-speed claims are asserted here.
Screenshots use fictional demonstration data. Confirm hardware compatibility and commercial terms with the team.
